plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Kimu Drive uses your location to send you nearby ride requests and show riders where you are.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Kimu Drive uses your location to send you nearby ride requests. If you allow it all the time, you keep receiving rides while the phone is locked.

android.extraProguardRules:
# The map runs inside a WebView (an Expo DOM component). R8 must leave the
# bridge between the page and native intact, or the map never calls back and
# the screen sits on "Loading map" for ever.
-keepclassmembers class * { @android.webkit.JavascriptInterface <methods>; }
-keepattributes JavascriptInterface
# @expo/dom-webview, the WebView DOM components use by default. Its native
# package really is expo.modules.webview (under node_modules/@expo/dom-webview,
# not node_modules/expo), and its message events are Kotlin records whose
# field names must survive R8 or the $$dom_ready handshake never completes.
-keep class expo.modules.webview.** { *; }
# react-native-webview, used when useExpoDOMWebView is false (LiveMap).
-keep class com.reactnativecommunity.webview.** { *; }
